newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi to send aid to Iran, Pakistan quake victims.
newsitem.headline: Saudi to send aid to Iran, Pakistan quake victims.

text.p: Saudi Arabia's King Fahd has ordered four plane-loads of aid sent to Iran and Pakistan to help victims of earthquakes, a Saudi newspaper said on Tuesday.

"As soon as the king learned of the earthquakes that hit Pakistan and the Islamic republic of Iran...he ordered that two planes for each be loaded with tents, blankets and food to be sent to both brotherly countries," Okaz newspaper said.

Up to 965 people were killed and 36,000 displaced in an earthquake measuring 5.5 on the Richter scale in northwest Iran on Friday. The quake occurred 16 hours after a strong tremor in Pakistan's Baluchistan province across Iran's southeastern border killed about 60 people.
